idea-plugin.name: GrillMyCode Companion
idea-plugin.description:
The companion to the GrillMyCode GitHub Action, which writes questions about a student's code to check that they understand it. This plugin shows those questions in the IDE, beside the code they ask about.

  • A list of your questions, file by file, in the GrillMyCode tool window.
  • A jump to the code. Double-click a question to open its files with the lines it asks about highlighted.
  • The whole question below the list, with the code as it was when the question was written.
  • A note when the code has changed since the questions were written.
  • New questions announced when they arrive after a push.
  • For instructors, each question's answer from the private answer key, beside the student's code. Students never see it.
  • Help with the workflow file: problems with the GrillMyCode step's settings marked as you type, and its settings and their values offered and described.
  • The Workflow Wizard in an editor tab, which tries your choice of files on the project and writes the workflow file for you.

To start, open a clone of your assignment repository, open the GrillMyCode tool window, and sign in to GitHub. If your school's GitHub organization restricts apps, an owner approves GrillMyCode Companion once.

The plugin reads your repository's questions issue, and asks GitHub whether your account can read the assignment's answer key, which a student's cannot. It writes nothing to GitHub and collects no usage data. The Workflow Wizard asks OpenRouter for its public list of models. See Your questions in JetBrains IDEs.
